summary: Common residential bounce houses are 13 x 13 ft (3.96 m) up to 15 x 15 ft; combo units run 12 x 16 to 14 x 20 ft; a standard 13 ft unit holds about 4 to 6 children. Operators plan footprint plus 3 to 5 ft clearance on every side and a 4 ft blower zone, so a 13 ft unit needs about 20 x 20 ft, with 12 to 15 ft of clear height overhead. Needs flat ground, an outlet within reach, gate and path widths for delivery, and no overhead wires or trees.
